explanation: Conway's 99-graph problem: is there a graph on 99 vertices in which adjacent pairs have exactly one common neighbour and non-adjacent pairs exactly two? Mathlib's LocallyLinear (every edge in exactly one triangle, triangles edge-disjoint) is equivalent to the first condition, and NonEdgesAreDiagonals encodes the second. The statement is faithful and open (equivalently, an srg(99, 14, 1, 2)).
